description: This file defines a SessionManager class responsible for managing user session data such as authentication tokens and email addresses within an Android application. It uses SharedPreferences for persistent storage.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: A class that manages user session state, including login status, authentication token, and email, using Android's SharedPreferences for persistent storage.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks whether a valid auth token exists, indicating an active session.

methods.name: getAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored authentication token, if any.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the stored user email, if any.

methods.name: saveSession
methods.description: Stores the authentication token and email to persist the user session.
